scope: The Capitol Records Building at 1750 Vine Street as photographed in July 2022, including the original connected podium, cylindrical tower, disc-like ledges, rooftop sign and spire. The painted mural and other street features are outside the model.

originalReview.notes: July 2009 aerial shows the rectangular podium around the cylinder, solid northeast arc and rooftop forms. Used only to corroborate durable building forms.
July 2022 street elevation shows the silver-white floor ledges, dark vertical glazing strips, rooftop sign, tapered mast and upper crown. The partly visible separate mural is not appearance evidence.

quallaSearch.notes: Two exact published Qualla originals were accepted. The July 2022 street view by Benoît Prieur is CC0. The July 2009 aerial by Jelson25 is the photographer’s explicitly public-domain own work. The separate street-level mural is outside the model.
